# xmatters_group_roster (Resource)

Returns a groupRoster in your xMatters instance that matches the provided criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Example of an xMatters group roster resource with advanced member configuration
resource "xmatters_group_roster" "advanced_roster" {
  id = "481086d8-357a-4279-b7d5-d7dce48fcd12"
  members = [
    {
      id          = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
      member_type = "PERSON"
    },
    {
      id          = "87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321"
      member_type = "PERSON"
    },
    {
      id          = "abcdefab-cdef-abcd-efab-cdefabcdefab"
      member_type = "GROUP"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the group in xMatters to manage membership.
- `members` (Attributes Set) A list of members to add to the group. The members can be people, devices, or other groups. If the member is a group, the group must be a dynamic team. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

### Read-Only

- `group` (Object) A reference to the group in which membership is being managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group))
- `last_updated` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Required:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the member to add to the group. The member can be a person, device, or group.
- `member_type` (String) The type of the member to add to the group. Available options are: PERSON, DEVICE, GROUP.


<a id="nestedatt--group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group`

Read-Only:

- `group_type` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `recipient_type` (String)
